name: manual_7d0320
claim: On Windows fresh installs, always probe both the hyphenated and space-separated winget install-directory naming for a given app (e.g. 'LM-Studio' vs 'LM Studio') — winget package IDs and the actual install folder name are not guaranteed to match.

decisions.notes: ensure_requirements.ps1 only checked %PROGRAMFILES%\LM-Studio\, but the real winget-installed LM Studio on this box was at %PROGRAMFILES%\LM Studio\ (space). This made Phase 1's binary check fail forever even though the server was reachable and working in Phase 2 — a confusing partial-pass state. Fixed by probing both spellings.
